preregistered_necessary_information_gate.stop_loss: DO NOT run full new Qwen inference solely to fix missing table inclusion. Isolated omissions are 2.5-3.1% of source tasks and the specific mechanism cannot explain the large original DEV500 K8 candidate-availability ceiling.

next_high_value_mechanism.primary_research_direction: Question-to-table/column/value binding and JOIN/filter semantics WITHIN already visible schema, not just adding missing tables or token keywords.
next_high_value_mechanism.protocol: Use unseen source-independent BIRD TRAIN physical DB tasks; freeze meaningful semantic mechanism and error detection gate before original fixed Qwen3.5-9B prospective matched experiments. No stronger model, teacher replacement, DEV500 tuning, or HOLDOUT300 peeking.
next_high_value_mechanism.risk: Original model SQL references only prompt-visible tables on all 64 independent source examples; errors can arise even with table visibility, from wrong column/entity/join/aggregation semantics.

limits: This is original publisher reference SQL table coverage from a conservative FROM/JOIN lexical parser, not gold adjudication or full SQL AST proof.
Two omitted-table validation cases were both wrong, but n=2 does not identify causality or generalizable gains.
The original valuation models direct and guarded have different tools/repair behavior, so 27/64 and 31/64 cannot be attributed to a table visibility intervention.
No model improvement was physically tested or demonstrated.
One-off original TRAIN cohort and independent four DB validation do not establish broad transfer.
